correctness.rationale: The exact pre-relocation three-colour urn includes one zero and an independent Bernoulli(a) fair signed side seed. Yule zero births give W>0, E[W]=1; square-integrable signed and total martingales yield e^{-t}Y(t)->D and e^{-t}S(t)/t->aW a.s. Since each physical relocation block adds at most two visits, log(n) occupation normalizations transfer to original discrete time. The zero-only branching equation F(s,t)=int_0^1 F(us,ut)^2(1-a+a/(1+u^2t^2))du solves uniquely to F=(1+s+a t arctan t)^(-1); multiplying the independent initial side factor produces (1-a+a/(1+t^2))/(1+s+a t arctan t). Conditional variance of D0|W=w is 2aw; conditional Chebyshev yields P(|D0/(aW)|>x)=O_a(log(x)/x^2). Initial side term has exact tail a/(1+ax), forcing lim x P(|Q_a|>x)=1 and infinite E|Q_a|. Independent high-precision quadrature checked nine transform identities and nine tail samples. Strict 0<a<1, symmetric nearest-neighbor steps and complete relocation outside 0 are essential; no uniform a endpoint or higher-dimensional extension.

value.rationale: The parameter-independent coefficient in the nonintegrable 1/x tail is a natural, nontrivial refinement of first-order monkey-walk localization. It exactly characterizes the second-order signed occupation imbalance and distinguishes finite bounded empirical imbalance from a heavy-tailed limiting observable. A researcher studying critical complete relocation can use the explicit joint transform and tail constant without resolving the full general impurity model.
